STEP 2 - Vessel: The food sits on a square white plate about 26 cm across, with an usable area of roughly 26×26, or about 600 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Roasted chicken pieces with herbs
- Broccoli florets
- Pepperoni pizza slice
- Roasted white potato chunks
- Roasted purple potato chunks
